Name: Dome
Description: Applies a smooth Gaussian bell centered on the square region, preserving the center and attenuating terrain toward the edges.

Params.Name: CoreStrength
Params.Label: Core strength
Params.Description: Sets the maximum dome value at the center of the square region.
Params.Tooltip: With Multiply merge, 1.0 preserves the center and lower values attenuate it as well as the edges.

Params.Name: Curvature
Params.Label: Curvature
Params.Description: Controls how quickly the Gaussian dome falls from the center toward the square boundary.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values keep the core tighter and produce stronger edge attenuation.
